title: Binance P2P Upgrades “P2P Hot Token Converter” Feature
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is thrilled to announce the upgrade to our "P2P Hot Token Converter" feature, where users can  seamlessly acquire selected hot tokens via the P2P Express zone  on the Binance App. How It Works: Head to  Binance P2P Express  on your Binance App.  Choose the hot token you wish to buy and select your preferred payment method. Complete payment to purchase USDT and the system will automatically convert the USDT into your selected hot token. You will then receive the hot token directly in your Funding Account. * Please note that this feature is only available on the Binance App. For the best experience, users can upgrade their App to version 2.98.0 or higher. For More Information:  How to Buy Hot Tokens via Binance P2P Express Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-10
